svg.aria-label: The path: lanes against time, with a now line at September 20, 2026. A ship-fence band under the axis says the fence LIFTED on September 20, when W4's first cut landed, and that no W5 ship lane has opened yet. Two input lanes from other epics: the W3 floor, FIX-1351, carries a bar that reaches the now line and reads landed — seats, channels and skills on disk. The W4 first cut, FIX-1407, now carries a solid bar that reaches the now line and reads first cut landed, epic In Review, with two documentation and dead-code strays left in backlog that are not part of the first cut. Then the three lanes of the set. FIX-1458, humans in seats, carries a solid in-flight bar crossing the now line, reading spec in review, pull request 1955, and still the only W5 work in flight, with a dashed not-started continuation running forward. FIX-1455, the kitchen-sink child epic, is a dashed not-started line beginning just after the now line, reading held, its own lifecycle, fence lifted but not started. The working-assemblies lane has no bar at all, only a label, reading not filed, the cut is now decidable, no duration to draw. The critical path is drawn in the gutter with a stop on all three set lanes: it runs from the exploration lane through FIX-1455, which is the reference app the proof is observed on and the done condition’s provisional owner, and only then to the assemblies lane. The proof is not reachable while the reference is still held. Under a divider, three related lanes that are not in the set: the manager-queue lab FIX-1430, org never optional FIX-1442, and the Collab park FIX-1341. The manager-queue lab and the Collab park are consumed or deferred and hold nothing, but org never optional is wrap-gating: the done condition requires an org-bound assembly, so W5 cannot wrap without it even though it is not a child.
svg.text: THE PATH — ONE LANE PER ROW OF THE SET, AGAINST TIME
